## 1. Verdict
144 bytes, exactly one byte differs from out2.srt: offset 128 `0x75` ('u' of "Quick flash cue") → `0xf5` — single MSB bit flip, python-verified (`diff offsets: [128] orig/flip: [('0x75','0xf5')]`). Distinct from flip2_040 in that it corrupts the FIRST byte of the LAST cue's text (vs a mid-word byte of the first cue), so the two mutants hit different damage/recovery positions; 128 = 8+16×8 fits the 8-byte-stride family. Invalid UTF-8 lead byte in a cue payload; the survival run passes over it. No defects.
